title: Triflorous
summary: TRIF'LOROUS, adjective [Latin tres, three, and flos, floris, flower.] Three-flowered; bearing three flowers; as a triflorous peduncle.

inlines.v: TRIF'LOROUS, adjective [Latin tres, three, and flos, floris, flower.] Three-flowered; bearing three flowers; as a triflorous peduncle.
